scope: Conditional on FDS radiation and convection histories; self-fed temperatures/masses, not autonomous FDS-free composition. Three separate fixed-type models. Pair data excluded from fitting/selection. No new test outputs.
chemical_power_definition: Predicted fuel-vapor rate *17425 kJ/kg: potential chemical power, NOT actual gas heat release or transferred heat.
time_sampling: FDS states interpolated to2s; rates left-sampled/integrated at2s for both fitting and comparisons; raw high-frequency devices preserved.
constraints: Mass nonincreasing in[0,1], T>=0C; class fuel release <= predicted wet/solid mass loss. Not energy conservation.
